content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The tall framed introduction pushes the shop photography almost entirely below the first screen, while repeated contact and opening-hours blocks unnecessarily lengthen the page.",
  "desktopNote": "The olive motif and prominent shop photography create a distinctive identity, but sparse product and gallery layouts and duplicated contact information weaken the finish.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 2,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate the contact section and footer into one contact area with a single address, opening-hours table, phone number and email; keep the legal footer compact.",
    "Shorten the phone hero by reducing the decorative motif, frame padding and action spacing so a meaningful portion of the shop photograph is visible above the fixed bar.",
    "Replace the oversized, mostly empty product cards with compact photo-led cards, and enlarge the desktop gallery images to use the available width."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the address, directions, opening hours and seasonal-hours note already displayed in the contact section directly above."
  ]
}
